_about: Every public-domain Richard Sibbes (1577-1635) text the Word Hoard holds. The target is the complete Grosart edition (Nichol's Series of Standard Divines, 7 vols, 1862-1864), Internet Archive OCR text (University of Toronto scans), raw and unconverted (the Edwards precedent). Grosart supersedes the 17th-century quartos and the 1809 Works, so those are listed as alternates, not fetched. CCEL: no Sibbes author page resolves (ccel.org/ccel/s/sibbes and s/sibbs probed 2026-10-02; work URLs return HTML, not ThML), so nothing is taken from CCEL. No Gutenberg Sibbes exists (searched 2026-10-02). Modern reprints are excluded.
